name: Nerima
tagline: Shinjuku in 19 minutes and Shibuya in 29 minutes. Served by 4 lines.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, served by Seibu Ikebukuro Line, Seibu Yurakucho Line, Seibu Toshima Line and Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 19 minutes to Shinjuku, 29 minutes to Shibuya and 50 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 40 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.2 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 40 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.2 m to 40.4 m, a difference of 5.2 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 練馬駅南店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 14 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 秀佑会東海病院, about 1059 m away and 総合東京病院, about 1375 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 4 lines serve the station: Seibu Ikebukuro Line, Seibu Yurakucho Line, Seibu Toshima Line and Toei Oedo Line. The lines are split between operators (Seibu runs 3 lines and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 85.

neighbours.note: 716 m away in a straight line. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nerima.
